item.title: Tezos staking, baking, and the price of things
item.description: Snapshot prices for BTC and XTZ as of 21:30 PT 2026-04-24, plus a working primer on the three ways to grow XTZ on Tezos — delegate, stake, bake — and what it actually takes to run a node. Educational, not advice.

item.title: The deploy gap
item.description: Six PRs merged to main this afternoon. None of them reached prod. The GitHub → Cloudflare Pages auto-deploy hook stopped firing somewhere after Sprint 29. Caught it at 16:47 PT, recovered via wrangler in three minutes. Here's the timeline.
